storage:

    sendposition: true
    allowwebchat: false
    includehiddenplayers: false
    hideifsneaking: false
    protected-player-info: false
    hide-if-invisiblity-potion: true
    hidenames: false

    showofflineplayers: false
    showspawnbeds: false
    showworldborder: true
    worldborderlabel: "Border"
  - class: org.dynmap.ClientComponent
    type: playermarkers
    showplayerfaces: true
    showplayerhealth: true
    showplayerbody: false
    hidebydefault: false
    label: "Players"
  - class: org.dynmap.ClientComponent
    type: timeofdayclock
    showdigitalclock: true
  - class: org.dynmap.ClientComponent
    type: coord
    label: "Location"
    hidey: false

display-whitelist: false

renderacceleratethreshold: 60

saverestorepending: true

tileupdatedelay: 30
enabletilehash: true

use-brightness-table: true
image-format: jpg-q85
use-generated-textures: true
correct-water-lighting: true
transparent-leaves: true
ctm-support: true
custom-colors-support: true
compass-mode: newnorth

render-triggers:
  - blockupdate
  - chunkpopulate
  - chunkgenerate

webpage-title: "Sjerred RLCraft Map"
tilespath: web/tiles
webpath: web
exportpath: export
webserver-bindaddress: 0.0.0.0
webserver-port: 8123
max-sessions: 20
disable-webserver: false
allow-symlinks: false
login-enabled: false
login-required: false
timesliceinterval: 0.0
maxchunkspertick: 50
progressloginterval: 100
updaterate: 3000
fullrenderplayerlimit: 1
updateplayerlimit: 0
per-tick-time-limit: 25
update-min-tps: 18.0
fullrender-min-tps: 19.0
zoomout-min-tps: 18.0
showplayerfacesinmenu: true
grayplayerswhenhidden: true
showlayercontrol: true
# Fresh RLCraft worlds are rendered into the flat overview first; make the
# public landing page open on that rendered view instead of an empty surface.
defaultzoom: 3
defaultworld: world
defaultmap: flat
persist-ids-by-ip: false
cyrillic-support: false
snapshotcachesize: 250
soft-ref-cache: true
verbose: false
dump-missing-blocks: false
","custom-normal-lowres.txt":"version: 0.20
templates:
  normal-lowres:
    enabled: true
    extrazoomout: 2
    maps:
      - class: org.dynmap.hdmap.HDMap
        name: flat
        title: "Flat"
        prefix: flat
        perspective: iso_S_90_lowres
        shader: stdtexture
        lighting: shadows
        mapzoomin: 2
      - class: org.dynmap.hdmap.HDMap
        name: surface
        title: "Surface"
        prefix: t
        perspective: iso_SE_60_lowres
        shader: stdtexture
        lighting: shadows
        mapzoomin: 2

[[Channels.Channel]]

subscriptions = ["info", "chat"]
mode = "PLAIN_TEXT"

[Messages]
# Mc2Discord 3.3.2's Forge 1.12.2 lifecycle formatter cannot format a server

start = ""
stop = ""

[Status.Channels]
# Do not register a placeholder channel with ID 0. This deployment has no
# Discord status-channel requirement.
Channel = []

[Features]
account_linking = false
